story: Rainy conditions dominated Stage 1 of the Tour of Magnificent Qinghai 2026. Early attacks delayed the break formation, which eventually consisted of three riders caught 25 km from the finish. Teams Polti Visit Malta and Terengganu controlled the peloton. A major crash in the final 3 km led to a chaotic sprint, with Salby narrowly clinching victory ahead of Leitao.
